notes:
Categories
- Merged duplicate categories that held the same thing twice: "Familys money" folded into "Family's money", Home Supplies now lives only under Housing, and Skin Care plus the body products filed under Home Supplies moved into Shopping > Self-care.
- New top-level Networking category (venue rental, event tickets, hosting, food & drinks, transport) for meetup spending that used to be scattered across six places.
- New top-level Health category (Doctor, Dental, Medication, Insurance) and Paperwork category (Visa & residency, Printing & scanning, Certificates).
- Existing transactions are moved automatically on first launch; 99 rows are relabelled and nothing is left on a retired category.

Ask AI for a category
- The category dialog now has a "What was this for?" box and an Ask AI button. Describe the purchase in your own words and get up to three suggestions with a reason each. Tapping one fills the fields; Save still commits.
- Available in both the Mark review screen and when you expand a row in History.

Fixes
- A short mapping rule no longer matches inside a longer word. A two-letter "CU" rule was silently forcing "Haircut", "documents" and "calculations" into Snacks.
